name: Kihara Rika
source:
A timid history teacher who is often being teased by students and is even unlucky enough to be harassed by the principal. 

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20180603050949fw_/http://assemblage.co.jp/asm/software/12tchr/t08_rika.htm]official website[/url]]
